text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, happy birthday! We're throwin' a
party
soon as we get back to the dorms,
yeah?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, I said party, but we got no funds,
so you're
gettin' the Tamamo family
special!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Gotta cut costs, so we'll cut up flyers 'n'
paint 'em
to hang up. Grub'll be
whatev's cheapest at the
market today.
How 'bout it, over the moon?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Mh-hmm, I'm so... excited. I've never...
felt so
happy...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, were you even listenin' just now?
I'm out
here plottin' to stuff ya with
cheap rice 'n' side
dishes. Whatcha so
happy 'bout?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because you planned this all for me... I
guess?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're as outta it as ever. What if I
told ya,
"We're fastin' for your
birthday!"? Wouldja still be
happy?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
F-fasting?! Ugh, but... You know me
better than
myself, Tama. If fasting is
how you celebrate,
then... I'm...
overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Dummy, I was just tryna pull one over
ya!
Yeesh, I'll whip up some fish for ya as
an apology.
Might even grab some eel...
